title: Choose the visual world for Centro Hispano
question: Minimal, red and yellow, your logo and photos kept. The roll assigned La Línea. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: La Línea
options.lineage: Metro de Madrid & Yerevan metro line diagrams
options.thesis: Learning Spanish drawn as one metro line: A1 to C2 are stations, each two months apart.
materials: one thick red line on white
options.viewport: White field, logo top-left, a single red line crossing the page with eight yellow-ringed stations A1→C2 and the monthly price under each; one line of headline, one Contact button.
options.risk: The metro metaphor turns gimmicky if it leaks past the level map and wayfinding into decoration.

raised.raise: Colour is the field, never the sprinkle: whole sections sit on solid yellow or red, nothing in between.
Every course carries a ruled stat table in tabular figures: frequency, length, duration, price.
Line states are drawn by stroke, not hue: solid for group levels, split for sub-levels, dashed for continuous courses.
Every photo carries its date and place caption like a station plaque.

options.label: Hoja de examen
options.lineage: Instituto Cervantes DELE exam papers and the CEFR grid
options.thesis: The site as a clean exam booklet: numbered sections, ruled answer lines, levels as a CEFR table.
options.viewport: A cover sheet: logo, “¿Y tú hablas español?” as question 1, a ruled answer line leading to the level table.
options.risk: Familiar school-document minimalism; many language schools land near here.

options.label: Copy-shop Zine
options.thesis: Every page a single typed column on one sheet of coloured stock.
options.viewport: Solar-yellow sheet, typed column, platen-enlarged headline running off the edge.
options.case: Community would recognise the fiesta flyer, but course prices lose clarity and the look is not minimal.
options.risk: Reads as a flyer, not a school.

options.label: Wax-pack Card
options.lineage: baseball card fronts and stat backs
options.thesis: Each course a card: level on the front, stat table on the back.
options.viewport: A dealt row of course cards with flip-to-stats.
options.case: Audience in Yerevan does not identify with baseball cards; clarity only partially holds.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Numbered lanes with state drawn in link lines.
options.viewport: Black lane grid with amber legends.
options.case: Loses both axes: not minimal, not a school, drops the red.
options.kept: State by stroke pattern, not colour.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.thesis: Events as pieced blocks with provenance.
options.viewport: A quilt grid of event photos.
options.case: Busy by nature; loses minimalism and course clarity.
options.kept: Every image carries date and place.

canonCard.label: Language-school standard
canonCard.thesis: Hero photo, headline, course cards, testimonials strip, contact form, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Full-width classroom photo with headline and Enrol button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other language school.
